SELECT
  t.name AS tenant_name,
  t.industry,
  d.orders_delivered,
  ROUND(d.avg_delivery_days, 2) AS avg_delivery_days,
  ROUND(d.median_delivery_days, 2) AS median_delivery_days,
  ROUND(d.p90_delivery_days, 2) AS p90_delivery_days,
  ROUND(d.pct_within_5_days, 4) AS pct_within_5_days
FROM tenants t
JOIN (
  SELECT
    o.tenant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS orders_delivered,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.delivered_at - o.placed_at)) / 86400.0) AS avg_delivery_days,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.delivered_at - o.placed_at)) / 86400.0) AS median_delivery_days,
    PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.delivered_at - o.placed_at)) / 86400.0) AS p90_delivery_days,
    AVG(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (o.delivered_at - o.placed_at)) / 86400.0 <= 5 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS pct_within_5_days
  FROM (
    SELECT
      ord.id,
      ord.tenant_id,
      ord.placed_at,
      (SELECT MAX(s.delivered_at)
       FROM fulfillments f
       JOIN shipments s ON s.fulfillment_id = f.id
       WHERE f.order_id = ord.id) AS delivered_at
    FROM orders ord
    WHERE ord.status = 'fulfilled'
      AND ord.placed_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND ord.placed_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM fulfillments f JOIN shipments s ON s.fulfillment_id = f.id
        WHERE f.order_id = ord.id
      )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM fulfillments f JOIN shipments s ON s.fulfillment_id = f.id
        WHERE f.order_id = ord.id AND s.delivered_at IS NULL
      )
  ) o
  GROUP BY o.tenant_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50
) d ON d.tenant_id = t.id
ORDER BY d.orders_delivered DESC, t.name ASC
LIMIT 50
